mom_func.slc:-.purpose: MoM sphere helpers -- all five spheres (Phase B1b, fanned out from the proven

mom_func.slc:MomCountChaosFoci.purpose: weighted count of Chaos buildings (COLOSSEUM 2 / MERCHANTS_GUILD 1) -- the deterministic floor under the random-windfall identity term

mom_func.slc:MomCountDeathFoci.purpose: weighted count of Death buildings (BARRACKS 1 / MECHANICIANS_GUILD 2) -- the additive city-focus term that squares the 5-column income matrix; Death keeps its army-fed units/3 identity term alongside it

mom_func.slc:MomGrantChaosBuilding.purpose: grant the Chaos-sphere milestone building (COLOSSEUM) in the player's first city -- the only unclaimed chaos-reading improvement, every other sphere's milestone being spoken for

mom_func.slc:MomGrantDeathBuilding.purpose: grant the Death-sphere themed building in the player's first city

mom_func.slc:MomGrantLifeBuilding.purpose: grant the Life-sphere themed building in the player's first city

mom_func.slc:MomGrantNatureBuilding.purpose: grant the Nature-sphere themed building in the player's first city

mom_func.slc:MomGrantSorceryBuilding.purpose: grant the Sorcery-sphere themed building in the player's first city

mom_func.slc:MomSpawnSphereUnit.purpose: spawn a sphere unit on a free non-water NEIGHBOUR of the first city, never the city tile: CTP2 draws exactly ONE unit per tile and orders own units by MaxMovePoints, so a fast summon on the capital permanently hides the garrison. GetNeighbor returns 0 at the map edge and does not write its out-arg, so the return value gates the read.

mom_gating.slc:-.purpose: GENERATED per-tribe who-gets-what wall via the engine mod functions. Identity comes from g.player (advance hook) and theCity.owner (build hooks); the thePlayer PARAMETER cannot carry identity -- CallMod builds it as SLIC_SYM_PLAYER and SetIntValue only writes SLIC_SYM_IVAR, so it always reads 0. Do not hand-edit.

mom_gating.slc:mod_CanCityBuildBuilding.purpose: same wall for improvements: deny off-sphere buildings, permit neutral ones.

mom_gating.slc:mod_CanCityBuildUnit.purpose: deny a city any unit whose sphere is not its owner tribe; neutral units always permitted. Identity via theCity.owner (proven to resolve, probe B2).

mom_gating.slc:mod_CanPlayerHaveAdvance.purpose: deny a tribe every ladder advance outside its own sphere. Guards on g.player FIRST (ResetCanResearch calls this once per advance per player) and intercepts every acquisition path including scenario-start seeding, so seed advances are unnecessary.

mom_magic.slc:-.purpose: MoM magic system (M1-M4) -- reconstructed from session log after H: FS corruption.

mom_magic.slc:MomMagicPoolTick.purpose: per-turn mana accrual into MomMagicCur, clamped at the per-sphere MomMagicMax ceiling (200-300, set by MomMagicSchoolGrant; 100 only as the pre-grant default). Gated to players 1..5 -- running for player 0 was the turn-10 crash. The old pool-overflow auto-summon is REMOVED: it zeroed the pool on cap, so the 50/100-cost workings were unreachable by construction.

mom_magic.slc:MomMagicSchoolGrant.purpose: apply per-school mana multipliers when a magic advance is granted

mom_magic.slc:MomRecalcMagicPerTurn.purpose: recompute a player's mana income from cities + owned mana nodes (base 10/turn)

mom_msg.slc:MomSummonNoMana.purpose: segment: insufficient-mana answer for the Summon arm; messagebox NOT alertbox, so no modal stacks on the Kill() path

mom_spells.slc:MomMsgNoMana.purpose: segment: insufficient mana for a spell (alertbox; distinct from mom_msg's summon variant)

mom_spells.slc:MomMsgNoTarget.purpose: segment: no enemy unit in range

mom_spells.slc:MomMsgNotChaos.purpose: segment: caster's sphere does not grant this spell

mom_spells.slc:MomSpellAICast.purpose: let AI players cast their sphere's spell when mana allows

mom_spells.slc:MomSpellMenuTick.purpose: per-turn latched spellbook prompt for HUMAN sphere players: re-arms MomSpellPromptArmed only after the pool drops back under 60% of max. Unlatched Message here floods the BeginTurn queue -> 0xC0000005 (measured 2/2).

mom_spells.slc:MomSpellShowBook.purpose: open the spellbook popup, choosing the per-sphere variant at call time
